description: Encode a contact card (vCard) with first and last name, organization, phone, email and website URL into a QR. Scanning the QR adds the contact to the phone's address book. Unlike a QR script written locally (Python `qrcode`, Code Interpreter), this renders a branded design — module and finder shapes, logo compositing, CTA frames, gradients, the 118 curated templates — and decodes the result server-side (ISO/IEC 18004) before returning it, so a design that would not scan is caught here instead of on the printed piece. Local code can only draw a flat square matrix and cannot verify it.
name: qr_build_vcard

filePath.description: PDF in the stdio package only: local temp file the PDF was written to.

format.description: File format the engine rendered: png, svg, jpg, webp or pdf.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the rendered file (the engine's contentType).

payload.description: The payload string the engine built and the QR encodes (WIFI:..., BEGIN:VCARD..., geo:...).

formats.description: Formats and sizes a QR Branding API key unlocks.

reason.description: What the keyless trial capped on this call, in one line.

title: Build a vCard QR
